manga.title: Rhodes Island's Records Of Originium - Rhine Lab
manga.description: Ifrit discovers an uninvited guest aboard Rhodes Island, a girl named Darya. Darya's small form casts a long shadow over Ifrit, Silence, and Saria as she conjures in them memories of a buried past.

manga.title: Rhodes Kitchen - Tidbits
manga.description: This is a collection of files regarding the daily lives of Rhodes Island's operators as they relate to food. May the smells of the kitchen warm our hearts and guide us true on the road ahead. The past is gone, it's good for now.
